verdict.rationale: GitHub's Marketplace lists a Slack integration, "Connect your code without leaving Slack", so a GitHub-to-Slack chat connection exists within GitHub's own ecosystem. The listing does not say who publishes it or confirm that repository and pull request notifications reach the channel. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of repo/PR notification delivery to Slack, any Discord or Microsoft Teams integration, configuration details for notification filtering, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can send repository and pull request notifications to chat tools like Slack, Discord, or Microsoft Teams

citations.quote: Connect your code without leaving Slack
